name: Invoice
descriptor: Lines of quantity times rate, an amount per line, and a total that is the sum of integer cents.
verify_checks: amount: the line amount is emitted
amount: the total is integer cents
pros: the line amount is derived from quantity and rate, so it cannot disagree
integer cents throughout: no float drift on a total
print is a capability, so the invoice prints without a second layout
one file you can email, with no service in the middle
cons: no tax, no discount, no currency conversion
no invoice numbering, no due dates, no payment status
no client records: the client is a text field on the line
it is a record of the lines, not a document generator
best_for: a simple bill you type once and print
avoid_if: you need tax rules, numbering or payment tracking
